import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"

/** The closed set of HTML elements this slot may render (members as.*). */
const SEMANTIC_TAGS = [
  "article", "aside", "blockquote", "code", "dd", "div", "dl", "dt", "figcaption", "figure",
  "footer", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "img", "li", "main", "nav", "ol", "p",
  "picture", "section", "small", "source", "span", "strong", "sup", "time", "ul",
] as const

type SemanticTag = (typeof SEMANTIC_TAGS)[number]

const baseClass: Partial<Record<SemanticTag, string>> = {
  h1: "font-heading text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance",
  h2: "font-heading text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance",
  h3: "font-heading text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight",
  h4: "font-heading text-xl font-semibold",
  h5: "font-heading text-lg font-semibold",
  h6: "font-heading text-base font-semibold",
  p: "leading-7 text-pretty",
  small: "text-sm text-muted-foreground",
  blockquote: "border-l-2 border-border pl-4 italic text-muted-foreground",
  code: "rounded-sm bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.9em]",
  ul: "list-disc pl-6 [&>li]:mt-1",
  ol: "list-decimal pl-6 [&>li]:mt-1",
  dt: "text-sm font-medium",
  dd: "text-sm text-muted-foreground",
  figcaption: "mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground",
  strong: "font-semibold",
}

/**
 * Typed semantic element: renders exactly one tag from the closed list with
 * theme-token typography, so sections never hand-roll heading or prose styles.
 */
function SemanticContent<T extends SemanticTag = "div">({
  as,
  className,
  ...props
}: { as?: T; className?: string } & Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<T>, "className">) {
  const tag = (as ?? "div") as SemanticTag
  if (!SEMANTIC_TAGS.includes(tag)) throw new Error(`SemanticContent: unsupported element <${tag}>`)
  return React.createElement(tag, {
    "data-slot": "semantic-content",
    "data-as": tag,
    className: cn(baseClass[tag], className),
    ...props,
  })
}

export { SemanticContent, SEMANTIC_TAGS, type SemanticTag }
